title: Ransomware encrypting core loan servers
summary: Double-extortion ransomware on the loan platform; data possibly stolen before encryption.
description: Microsoft Defender for Endpoint raised 'Ransomware behaviour detected' on LN-APP-02 and LN-DB-01 (India loan-processing cluster) at 06:41 UTC. Volume shadow copies were deleted with vssadmin, files renamed to .lockd, and a ransom note README_RESTORE.txt claims 300 GB of data was stolen and will be leaked in 5 days unless paid. Beaconing to 198.51.100.23 over HTTPS every 60s since 2 days earlier. A domain admin account (svc_backup) was used for lateral movement via RDP. The loan ledger for ~180,000 Indian and ~12,000 EU customers is on the affected database.

sentinel.title: Multi-stage incident involving Ransomware & Lateral movement on multiple endpoints
